prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-ready isolated transparent RGBA game sprite, machine_pop_pair_body, for a small popcorn factory mobile game.
Input images: image 1 is the approved scene/style reference only. Image 2 is the existing single popcorn machine BODY reference for camera and mechanical interfaces. Image 3 is the reusable moving HEAD reference solely to size the empty circular sockets: do not draw the head. Image 4 is the existing FRONT part solely for style; no detached extra pieces.
Primary request: create a new coherent TWO-SOCKET EMPTY POPCORN MACHINE CHASSIS, a wide low teal machine platform with exactly TWO large empty circular stainless-steel kettle receiving bays. Two equally sized empty round bowl sockets sit side by side along the isometric left-to-right ground axis, one continuous teal rectangular chassis beneath, steel lips, sturdy short feet. Both empty metal bowl interiors and both openings clearly visible. Preserve a simple generous depth so the separate old lid/stirrer head could be positioned above each circular socket. Two sockets total.
Style: closely match the supplied approved game references, polished simplified toy-like industrial 3D render with clean broad surfaces, readable shapes and bevelled rounded corners, minimal fasteners. Orthographic isometric ground axes about (1,0.55) and (-1,0.55), same camera as the old machine, soft light from upper left. Teal #219da5 body, cool steel #555f69 interior, tiny muted gold functional pivot accents. This is a low chassis, not a full production line.
Composition: show one complete machine body centered, fully visible silhouette and feet, generous transparent margin on all sides. Near semicircular lips may be low, allowing later standalone old front guards to occlude. No separate items, no multipart sheet.
Constraints: truly transparent background with original alpha, no floor plane, no backdrop, no baked checkerboard. Exactly two empty sockets. NO moving lids, agitators, head motors or overhead work heads. NO popcorn, kernels, cups, boxes, people, text, numbers, logos, pictograms, price, UI, arrows, watermarks, smoke, conveyors or decorative clutter. Do not reproduce any text or products from the scene. Output only this one independent body.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: machine_pop_quad_body, ONE isolated independent transparent game machine chassis.
Input images: image 1 is the APPROVED TWO-SOCKET chassis appearance and camera reference; image 2 is the original moving kettle head solely for socket size, never draw the head; image 3 is approved overall game style.
Create the FOUR-SOCKET family version of reference 1: one coherent broad teal low chassis, exactly FOUR EMPTY equal-sized circular stainless kettle receiving bowls arranged as TWO BY TWO in an isometric grid. The two visible ground axes are about (1,0.55) and (-1,0.55); all four socket centers follow that grid; both back sockets must remain clearly visible, not hidden. Make the chassis longer in depth only as needed to accommodate the second row. Preserve the bowl size, steel lips, teal thick side bars, modest gold pivot pins, clean broad beveled surfaces and upper-left soft light of the approved pair body. Each round bowl remains completely empty; a separate old lid/stirrer is installed later.
Centered complete four-socket body, orthographic camera, generous transparent margin with all feet visible. Low near-side lips, no overhead parts. Exactly four empty bowl openings, NOT six, not an exploded or tiled asset sheet. Truly TRANSPARENT background and real alpha; transparent pixels around the complete silhouette; do not paint a background, floor, checkerboard or external glow.
NO work heads, lids, agitators, motors above the bowls, cups, popcorn, boxes, kernels, products, text, digits, UI, icons, logos, people, decorative clutter. One chassis sprite only.

Use case: background-extraction. EDIT TARGET image 1: the FOUR-SOCKET teal empty machine body just generated. Supporting reference image 2 is a correctly transparent two-socket sprite.
Change ONLY the background of image 1. REMOVE EVERY gray-and-white checkerboard square and turn the entire area outside the four-socket machine silhouette into genuinely transparent alpha pixels. Output a PNG with a real RGBA alpha channel. A checkerboard is NOT transparency and MUST NOT remain as visible pixels. Do NOT make another opaque RGB illustration, do NOT replace with white, black or colored background, and do not add a shadow or halo.
Preserve the complete original machine pixel appearance: all four empty bowls, teal chassis, feet, steel rims, perspective, lighting and scale exactly. Keep interior metal bowl floors opaque. Keep all four sockets empty. No new content, no text, no detached parts. One isolated clean transparent sprite.

Generate machine_pop_socket_cover, one isolated game sprite on a transparent background. Match the supplied teal popcorn machine image, its orthographic isometric camera, broad polished bevels and soft upper-left lighting. Draw just ONE plain inactive socket blanking plate: a solid low circular steel disk seen as an ellipse from this camera, with a thin teal edge and a shallow flat top, tiny recessed fasteners, no protruding handle. It is a flat removable cover sized to lie across one empty bowl opening. The whole cover is visible, centered with ample transparent margin. PNG with transparency. No background scene, ground, checkerboard pattern, shadow halo, text, markings, glyphs, logo, cup, popcorn, working head, motor, stirring paddle, pipe or extra parts. This is only the detached circular cover, not a machine.

Generate machine_pop_hex_body, one isolated game sprite on a transparent background. The supplied image is the approved TWO-SOCKET empty popcorn chassis. Draw its SIX-SOCKET larger family version: one connected low teal platform containing exactly SIX empty circular metal kettle sockets arranged in a THREE BY TWO isometric grid. All six round openings must be clearly visible. Preserve the same individual bowl dimensions and simple steel/teal construction, broad bevels, short feet, muted gold pivots, orthographic isometric camera and upper-left lighting as the reference. The near lips remain low. The machine is wider and deeper, not taller. Exactly six equal empty bowls, one chassis. Center it and include the complete silhouette and all feet with ample transparent margin. PNG with transparency. No background scene, ground plane, checkerboard pattern, external halo, text, markings, logo, UI, product, cups, popcorn, kernels, motor, lid, working head, stirring paddle, pipe, detached parts or asset sheet.

Generate machine_pop_double_carrier, one isolated empty game sprite on a transparent background. Match the supplied popcorn machine's simplified polished teal and cool steel materials, broad bevels, orthographic isometric camera and soft light from upper left. Draw ONE compact detachable empty metal carrier for TWO portions: a shallow rounded rectangular steel tray divided into exactly two equal open receiving depressions by a low central rib, with teal outer rim and small teal underside supports. It is a small receiving accessory beside a popcorn machine. Empty and hollow, no contents. Complete centered silhouette with generous transparent margins. PNG with transparency. No background scene, floor, checkerboard pattern, halo, text, symbols, digits, cup, popcorn, kernel, cardboard box, machine body, head, motor or extra parts. Only the single two-portion empty carrier.
